name: openbb_currency_snapshots
description:
Snapshot of current exchange rates against a base currency through the OpenBB Platform (obb.currency.snapshots).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): base (default usd); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, polygon; default fmp).
One pair: av_forex_rate; history: openbb_forex_historical, yf_forex_history. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; polygon needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"base": "eur"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
